sentences.text: IAIS 成立于1994年，是依瑞士民法设立的非营利社团（verein）。
sentences.evidence: The IAIS was established in 1994 and operates as a verein, a type of non-profit organisation under Swiss Civil Law.

sentences.text: IAIS 由国际清算银行（BIS）托管。
sentences.evidence: The IAIS is hosted by the Bank for International Settlements (BIS).

sentences.text: 其委员会体系由执行委员会领导，执委会38名成员来自世界不同地区。
sentences.evidence: led by an Executive Committee whose 38 members come from different regions of the world
